title: Strict finite-free internal Hom formula at a prescribed colimit cocone
statement:
Let C be a category with objects in universe u+1 and morphisms in u, let J be a Grothendieck topology with sheafification of abelian groups in u+1 whose local equivalences are the locally bijective maps, and let R be a sheaf of commutative rings in u+1. Use module sheaves and complexes [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], the fixed strict tensor and K-injective Hom models [def-sfb-internal-hom-strict-models], and the canonical normalized comparison a and augmentation denominator v [def-sfb-internal-hom-strict-roof]. Let I be a small filtered category in u+1, T:I -> Mod_R a diagram with each T_i isomorphic to a finite power of the unit module (including power zero), and c a specified colimit cocone [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let P be K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex], suppose Continuous(P) for I, and let L be a complex with L^n=0 for all n below one integer b.

Write F=homFixed(P), G_B=tensorFixed(B), and I(L) for the fixed K-injective replacement. Then c is a colimit, colim_i a_(T_i) is a quasi-isomorphism, and a is evaluation-normalized. The separate Hom postcomparison colim_i F(T_i tensor I(L)) -> F(colim_i(T_i tensor I(L))) is a quasi-isomorphism, and colim_i(T_i tensor F(L)) -> (colim_i T_i) tensor F(L) is an isomorphism. Every stage numerator a_(T_i) and denominator v_(T_i), and both maps at the specified vertex c.pt, are quasi-isomorphisms. The canonical colimit square post(T,G_(F(L))) followed by a_(colim T) equals colim_i a_(T_i) followed by post(T,G_(I(L)) composed with F). Finally, for every c-leg T_i -> c.pt, its image under tensor(-,L) and then F followed by v_(c.pt) equals v_(T_i) followed by its image under tensor(-,I(L)) and F. No bound on I(L) or F(L) is assumed.

proof.text: The faithful module-sheaf forgetful functor is exact and preserves filtered colimits. Transfer exact filtered colimits from abelian sheaves and apply the existing filteredColimit_comparison to T,P,L. This gives the stage and canonical vertex numerator and denominator quasi-isomorphisms, the tensor postcomparison isomorphism, and the colimit square. Exact filtered colimits preserve the diagram of stage numerator quasi-isomorphisms. comparison_existsUnique supplies evaluation normalization.

internalHom_filtered_continuity gives the combined tensor-Hom postcomparison. Tensor by a fixed complex preserves coefficient-sized colimits: use the independent-universe tensor colimit and additive API, the degree-zero single functor, and the total bifunctor colimit instances. Apply colimit.post_post and two-out-of-three to cancel the Hom image of the tensor postcomparison, obtaining the separate Hom postcomparison. No lower bound on the K-injective replacement or on Hom is used.

The unique colimit-point isomorphism colimit T -> c.pt transports the numerator quasi-isomorphism by naturality. Express the denominators as the components of the natural transformation obtained by applying the strict Hom functor to tensor(-,eta_L). The same naturality transports the denominator quasi-isomorphism and gives its square for every specified c-leg. Assemble these clauses with the unchanged colimit square.

theorem strictColimitFormula_of_finiteFree
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    {I : Type (u + 1)} [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I]
    (T : I ⥤ WeilConjectures.SfbHomFilteredColimit.Modules.{u + 1, u, u}
      J R) (c : Cocone T)
    (hc : Nonempty (IsColimit c))
    (hfree : ∀ i : I, ∃ d : ℕ, Nonempty
      (T.obj i ≅ limit (Discrete.functor (fun _ : Fin d ↦
        SheafOfModules.unit ((sheafCompose J
          (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj R)))))
    (P L : CochainComplex (WeilConjectures.SfbHomFilteredColimit.Modules.{u + 1, u, u}
      J R) ℤ)
    (hP : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients
      (J := J) (R := R) P)
    (hcont : WeilConjectures.SfbHomFilteredColimit.Continuous.{u + 1, u, u}
      J R (I := I) P)
    (hL : ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < b → IsZero (L.X n)) :
    Nonempty (IsColimit c) ∧
    QuasiIso (colimMap (Functor.whiskerLeft T
      (WeilConjectures.SfbHomFilteredColimit.comparison.{u + 1, u, u} J R P L))) ∧
    WeilConjectures.SfbHomFilteredColimit.Normalized.{u + 1, u, u} J R P L
      (WeilConjectures.SfbHomFilteredColimit.comparison.{u + 1, u, u} J R P L) ∧
    QuasiIso (colimit.post
      (T ⋙ WeilConjectures.SfbHomFilteredColimit.tensorFixed.{u + 1, u, u} J R
        ((WeilConjectures.coefficientHomResolution.{u, u + 1, u} J R).obj L))
      (WeilConjectures.SfbHomFilteredColimit.homFixed.{u + 1, u, u} J R P)) ∧
    IsIso (colimit.post T
      (WeilConjectures.SfbHomFilteredColimit.tensorFixed.{u + 1, u, u} J R
        ((WeilConjectures.SfbHomFilteredColimit.homFixed.{u + 1, u, u} J R P).obj L))) ∧
    (∀ i, QuasiIso
      ((WeilConjectures.SfbHomFilteredColimit.comparison.{u + 1, u, u} J R P L).app
        (T.obj i))) ∧
    (∀ i, QuasiIso
      (WeilConjectures.SfbHomFilteredColimit.roofDenominator.{u + 1, u, u} J R P L
        (T.obj i))) ∧
    QuasiIso
      ((WeilConjectures.SfbHomFilteredColimit.comparison.{u + 1, u, u} J R P L).app c.pt) ∧
    QuasiIso
      (WeilConjectures.SfbHomFilteredColimit.roofDenominator.{u + 1, u, u} J R P L c.pt) ∧
    (colimit.post T
        (WeilConjectures.SfbHomFilteredColimit.tensorFixed.{u + 1, u, u} J R
          ((WeilConjectures.SfbHomFilteredColimit.homFixed.{u + 1, u, u} J R P).obj L)) ≫
          (WeilConjectures.SfbHomFilteredColimit.comparison.{u + 1, u, u} J R P L).app
            (colimit T) =
      colimMap (Functor.whiskerLeft T
        (WeilConjectures.SfbHomFilteredColimit.comparison.{u + 1, u, u} J R P L)) ≫
          colimit.post T
            (WeilConjectures.SfbHomFilteredColimit.tensorFixed.{u + 1, u, u} J R
              ((WeilConjectures.coefficientHomResolution.{u, u + 1, u} J R).obj L) ⋙
                WeilConjectures.SfbHomFilteredColimit.homFixed.{u + 1, u, u} J R P)) ∧
    (∀ i,
      (WeilConjectures.SfbHomFilteredColimit.homFixed.{u + 1, u, u} J R P).map
          ((WeilConjectures.SfbHomFilteredColimit.tensor.{u + 1, u, u} J R).map
            (c.ι.app i, 𝟙 L)) ≫
        WeilConjectures.SfbHomFilteredColimit.roofDenominator.{u + 1, u, u} J R P L c.pt =
      WeilConjectures.SfbHomFilteredColimit.roofDenominator.{u + 1, u, u} J R P L
          (T.obj i) ≫
        (WeilConjectures.SfbHomFilteredColimit.homFixed.{u + 1, u, u} J R P).map
          ((WeilConjectures.SfbHomFilteredColimit.tensor.{u + 1, u, u} J R).map
            (c.ι.app i,
              𝟙 ((WeilConjectures.coefficientHomResolution.{u, u + 1, u} J R).obj L))))
